reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis relies on trapping Cu into the W lattice via rapid quenching, but W–Cu is immiscible with a large atomic size mismatch, making a metastable solid solution highly unlikely; the proposed mechanism contradicts well-established phase equilibria.
reasons.testability: The test is clearly described with specific measurements and a falsification criterion, but the impracticality of achieving the hypothesized metastable phase makes the test moot.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it proposes a physically unsound mechanism (W(Cu) solid solution) that would not guide productive research on W–Cu composites.
